calc_items.title: Absolute neutrophil count
calc_items.question: WBC 2,000/µL with neutrophils 10% and bands 5%. Calculate the absolute neutrophil count.

calc_items.title: Corrected reticulocyte count
calc_items.question: Reticulocytes 8%, haematocrit 20%, normal haematocrit taken as 40%. Calculate the corrected reticulocyte percentage.

calc_items.title: Absolute reticulocyte count
calc_items.question: RBC 2.5 million/µL with reticulocytes 6%. Calculate the absolute reticulocyte count.

calc_items.title: Transfusion volume (arithmetic only)
calc_items.question: Calculate a 10 mL/kg volume for a 17-kg child.

calc_items.title: Corrected calcium
calc_items.question: Measured calcium 7.2 mg/dL, albumin 2.0 g/dL. Using the conventional Ca + 0.8 × (4 − albumin), calculate the corrected calcium.
calc_items.working: 7.2 + 0.8 × (4 − 2) = 8.8 mg/dL; the correction is unreliable in critical illness — measure ionised calcium.
